saw_lines: Protein buyers read the ingredient list on the back, then reorder the same tub for months once it sits well.
So the sale is won in the opening line, where the buyer decides if the ingredients are worth a second look.
Your ads lean on one opener, 12 of 28 copy ads open on “always sold out”, so test three new openers built on your ingredient list, bloating and taste.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: 12 of your 28 copy ads open on the same “always sold out” line, so most buyers hear one pitch again and again. Test three new openers built on the ingredient list, bloating and taste, each against that line.
None of your 29 live ads carries a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust you over a bigger rival. Collect one count, like reviews or orders shipped, and open the next three ads with it.
None of your 28 copy ads mentions an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Open the next three ads with a first order discount and name the delivery time in the same line.

2 ads have run 60+ days, but none of the 27 newer ads reuses their opening line, so the proven angle is never reused. Build three new ads as variations of the oldest winner, keeping its opener and adding one offer.

ads_1: Ingredient, bloating and taste openers, tested against the current sold out line
